title: Auto TS/JS review flow and Biome/ESLint adapter v1

output.summary: Approve automatic TS/JS review execution and Biome/ESLint adapter evidence.

approvedRows.question: Should wiki_implement auto-run configured review packs for changed TS/JS files?
approvedRows.currentState: Review packs can be run manually, but wiki_implement does not invoke them as part of normal review flow.
approvedRows.desiredState: wiki_implement auto-runs TS/JS review packs, creates review acceptance links from implementation evidence, and permits disabling auto review.
approvedRows.rationale: Review packs should contribute to loop exit without requiring callers to manually assemble evidence reports.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users get type/lint blockers surfaced during Implementation closure.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers must keep auto review bounded and evidence-only.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Needs API wiring and facade tests.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Auto review operationalizes the owned review architecture.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: User asked to proceed after TS/JS runner was added.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Connects review packs to wiki_implement flow.
agentAssessment.rationale: Explicit disable flag and acceptance-link synthesis preserve safety.

approvedRows.desiredOutcome: wiki_implement automatically includes TS/JS review evidence when applicable.
approvedRows.successSignal: Facade test proves failing typecheck script creates review_blocking_diagnostic.
nonGoals: Do not persist review evidence to disk.

approvedRows.question: Should CodeWiki add a direct Biome/ESLint review adapter?
approvedRows.currentState: TS/JS typecheck evidence exists, but JS lint evidence has no direct owned adapter.
approvedRows.desiredState: Add a Biome/ESLint language pack that detects project-local tools or lint scripts, runs shell-free through adapter runner boundaries, and normalizes diagnostics.
approvedRows.rationale: Linters are low-level sensors that CodeWiki should own directly instead of delegating to pi-lens or pi-posher.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users get style/lint blockers as normalized implementation evidence.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers must keep parser support small and tested with fake outputs.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Needs language adapter code and tests.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: This is the next low-level adapter after TS/JS typecheck.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: User asked to proceed with direct linters as adapters.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Adds first JS lint adapter while preserving CodeWiki semantic authority.

approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Biome/ESLint pack detects, runs, and parses lint evidence.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove detection, run budget, ESLint JSON parsing, Biome JSON parsing, and normalized diagnostics.
nonGoals: Do not require Biome or ESLint as package dependencies.

currentStatePacket.summary: Review packs exist but need automatic flow and JS lint adapter.
